items.title: Bill Watrous interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 26, 1999
items.q: You know Roswell Rudd and I used to spell each other between the Cinderella Club and the Riviera, all the time we were there.

ctx.x: I wound up playing lots of Dixieland music. In between gigs with Winding I was playing with these little bands that we’d play — I used to sub for Cutty Cutshall at Nick’s sometimes, and I would play at the Riviera Club. If I had nothing to do I would just go out and play. You know Roswell Rudd and I used to spell each other between the Cinderella Club and the Riviera, all the time we were there. And in those days, Roswell was some kind of player. And by the way, this table may not necessarily be here.
You think it’s like fiction in our imagination?
